derivation.changeSummary: Reworked common foundation as scoped public attributes with focus-visible, forced colors and reduced-motion rules. Separated explicit global reset and optional installed/local font selection; omitted remote assets, original scripts and global defaults from component entries. Plain CSS strings use identical source bytes. T06 native-renderer correction: decorate only nonempty errors so persistent empty polite regions remain visually empty. T10: preserved the six pilot/base source bytes; expanded scoped base embedding to all 54 web entries. Added source-backed dropdown/clipping adaptations for LanguageSwitcher, Resize and VisuallyHidden. Added inheritance-safe shadowStyles raw base/component/all strings without token defaults, reset or font opt-ins; ordinary CSS and existing styles strings retain their previous token/base semantics.

derivation.changeSummary: Adapted six pilot styles to documented public component/part/state/variant/size attributes with native semantics left to adapters; added wrapping, constrained viewport layouts and non-color state cues. Omitted original DOM-specific classes, JavaScript, icon assets and unrelated components; generated ordinary CSS and identical runtime-free strings. Calendar in-range uses a dashed border rather than outline so the independent focus-visible outline and forced-colors Highlight focus cue remain available; range endpoints retain double borders. T06 native-renderer corrections: selected Calendar dates use Canvas/ButtonText with non-color state borders in forced colors; nonwrapping digits/weekday labels and intrinsic table width scroll locally under narrow text enlargement; native DateInput popup receives explicit centered viewport-bounded sizing. Calendar table scrolling is isolated in a private native wrapper with focus-ring padding, keeping month navigation and footer actions stationary; narrow headers use separate heading/navigation rows to avoid year-arrow overlap. T10: adapted additional frozen component sections to exact native component-specific public parts, per-part states and orthogonal presentation axes; all 54 web entries are exported, with an intentionally selector-free asset-only Favicon entry. Component-CSS derivative paths here include only sections actually used from this preserved kit CSS. HTML-only additions use independently authored functional/native geometry and token references rather than copied expressive HTML text/code. Added native control/error/progress/navigation/overlay layouts, noncolor state borders, wrapping, viewport/safe-area constraints, a source-matched indeterminate spinner loop with a stable reduced-motion alternative, and raw inheritance-safe shadowStyles strings. No original JavaScript, font, icon or image assets were copied. All six pilot CSS source bytes and prior generated standalone CSS inputs remain unchanged; new native visual/behavior acceptance remains pending. T10 review fix1: current Pagination matches aria-current=true/page and public current state, with narrow previous/next visual row before the number row while preserving DOM order. Desktop MainMenu submenus have an internal 70vh scroll bound. TabBar is fixed at the bottom with equal nonwrapping columns and complete wrapped labels. Breadcrumb preserves one reduced path row with permitted final-label visual ellipsis; FileUpload filename ellipsis retains complete underlying accessible text. Blocked noninteractive StepIndicator text uses the readable official subtle text token rather than disabled text, preserving dashed state borders and unchanged font size/opacity. Real native progress indicators are exempted from decorative ring rotation/borders; no progress values are fabricated. Additional actual native React contrast correction: regular Footer anchors inherit the readable official basic text/surface pair, retaining privacy-link primary emphasis, full names, underlines and separate focus outlines; no token value, font size or opacity was changed. Controller-authorized Carousel extension: the new bounded stop-intent part shares native playback-control presentation and disabled cues, with paused/disabled per-part states. It is conditionally rendered by the native owner only for multi-slide committed playback intent inhibited from actual advancement; CSS adds no intent, timer or label policy. The owned decorative TabBar current indicator is positioned out of flow over its existing current border, so it does not add a flex row or shift the active icon/label. Only its decorative glyph is clipped; complete navigation labels, native current semantics and the independent focus outline remain unchanged. Actual native complex-table correction: header cells, data cells and sort triggers preserve natural word boundaries with normal overflow wrapping/keep-all word breaking. This overrides the generic anywhere foundation for table text so meaningful long references retain intrinsic widths and trigger the real locally scrollable region/controls, rather than collapsing into vertical glyph columns. No arbitrary table minimum width, font reduction, content hiding or header-association change was introduced. Bounded post-acceptance layout/contrast correction: CoachMark popovers retain their nominal width but are capped by the actual parent content width as well as viewport gutters, avoiding nested TutorialPanel clipping without changing position, wrapping or overflow policy. HelpPanel topic-trigger visible text uses the official text-information token instead of the icon-information token. Noninteractive disabled-tone Badge labels use readable subtle text for outline/pastel and basic text on their unchanged filled surface, preserving tone fill/border and forced-color behavior. The independently authored Image figure uses a zero-minimum fractional grid track so its real image intrinsic width cannot enlarge the parent track. No token literal, font size, opacity, semantic relationship or native event behavior was changed.
